message: More small fixes. A target logged every so many minutes over a sunrise-to-sunset window now counts each day’s own daylight, and one started late no longer stays shorter the next day. A task waiting for a lighter day no longer counts tasks you can’t do today (hidden by vacation, in a paused project, or waiting on something) toward how full the day is. A task waiting for a sunny day isn’t let out while vacation or a paused project hides it, and the forecast moving it no longer counts as you putting it off. Activity no longer lists the same thing twice when two devices did it. Done in Sort the Inbox keeps what you picked on the card you’re on. The names field in Track replies scrolls instead of pushing the answers field under the keyboard, Plan a trip, Add existing task and Link a recipe lose an extra gap at the top, and the keyboard no longer covers the last results when you pick a substitute or an exercise.
